snippet.title: System Says Normal - Reveal Trailer #indiehorror  #horrorgame  #indiegame
snippet.description:
You've been assigned to Baseline Corporation. Monitor the cameras. Log the anomalies. File your reports. The system will tell you what's normal.
Trust the system.

System Says Normal is a bureaucratic horror game about a night shift operator who follows protocol - and slowly realizes the protocol might be the problem. Check cameras. Report anomalies. Do not question.
The previous operator left no handover notes. His belongings are still in the break room.

🔔 Add to your wishlist - coming soon on Steam and GOG (PC & MAC OS).
👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529110/System_Says_Normal/

Game by solo developer from Poland - Wishlist to support game developer.
